Cc: FastPay Ops <ops@fastpay.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:14:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — two-week headroom for Black Friday spike

Jonas,

Hope you’re well. We’ve completed a load test for a new checkout flow and it looks like we’ll need a short window of extra throughput to validate end-to-end before Black Friday. Our ops team expects a concentrated burst over 36–48 hours (roughly 1.2M extra token-units).

Can Redwood offer a short-window capacity increase or an interim "headroom" arrangement that avoids long-term commit changes? We’re primarily worried about rate limits and surprise overrun charges.

If possible, we’d like a clear fee schedule for:
- A 48-hour elevated cap (1.2M token-unit buffer)
- The per-unit overrun rate if we exceed the buffer
- Any required lead time or signatures

I’ve attached an excerpt of our October usage and the test logs (FP_usage_report_Oct2026.csv). Happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Elena Moreno
Head of Platform, FastPay
elena@fastpay.com

Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — two-week headroom for Black Friday spike

Elena — thanks for the note and the usage snapshot. Appreciate the heads-up.

Short answer: yes, we can do a short-window headroom arrangement that doesn’t require changing your existing monthly commit. High-level options below; I’ve looped in Priyom to confirm billing and contract mechanics.

1) Temporary headroom (48 hours): we can provision a dedicated burst window of 1.25M token-units. Flat fee option: $3,500 flat for the window, which covers up to that buffer and prevents automatic per-unit overrun billing during the 48 hours.

2) Metered buffer: no flat fee; buffer applies, and overrun beyond 1.25M billed at an elevated short-window rate of $0.012 / token-unit (instead of standard $0.009).

3) Safety fallback (recommended): automatic soft-throttle once buffer is consumed and a notification webhook to your ops team — avoids unintended cost shocks.

Lead time: we can enable within 6 business hours if you send official approval (email OK). For billing, we can do a one-off invoice tied to deal FP-4382 or apply it as a pro-rated addendum to November’s invoice.

If you prefer, we can produce an amendment doc and e-signature link — Priyom, can you confirm which route is faster from finance?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
